title: The IBISCO survey. I. Multiphase discs and winds in the Seyfert galaxy Markarian 509
question: What are the molecular gas content, disc kinematics, stability and molecular winds in the Seyfert 1.5 galaxy Mrk 509, and are the winds AGN- or SN-driven?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.014 mJy/beam; cube rms 0.38 mJy/beam per 10.6 km/s channel

what.value: Stellar mass and SFR (5.1±0.5 Msun/yr) from SED decomposition

evidence.quote: The rest-frame SED is fitted with a three components model using the approach described in (cite: gruppioni2016).
a black hole with mass $M_{bh} = 10^{8.04}~\mathrm{M_{\odot}}$ (cite: bentz)
with velocity 290 km/s and mass outflow rate $\dot{M}_{of}$ = 5 $\mathrm{M_{\odot}/yr}$

recipe.goal: Calibrate and image continuum and CO(2-1)
recipe.method: Pipeline calibration, uvcontsub, tclean natural weighting, hogbom

recipe.goal: Measure continuum flux and CO line flux, luminosity and gas mass
recipe.method: 2D image-plane fit for continuum; three-Gaussian fit of spectrum; L'CO from Solomon relation; M_H2 using alpha_CO from Accurso
assumptions: alpha_CO = 3.3 Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1 from stellar mass M*=1.2e11 Msun

recipe.method: 3D tilted-ring fit; first run free inclination and PA, second run inclination fixed to 44 deg; residual cube, PV diagrams
key_parameters: kinematic centre fixed to continuum position; PV slit 0.45 arcsec wide
assumptions: inclination 44 deg from GALEX UV imaging

recipe.goal: Dynamical mass and Toomre Q map
recipe.method: M_dyn = r v_rot^2/2G; Q_gas = a v_rot sigma/(pi R G Sigma_gas) pixel by pixel from moments 0 and 2
key_parameters: a=1 up to R=1.1 arcsec, a=1.4 beyond

recipe.method: Residual cube spectra in regions A and B; Mdot=3 M v98/R; optically thin/thick alpha_CO; escape velocity; momentum load
assumptions: alpha_CO = 0.3 (optically thin) and 0.8 (thick) Msun (K km/s pc^2)^-1

recipe.method: Nuclear disc fit with inclination 66 deg, PA 330 deg fixed; v_rot and dispersion free, first guesses 80 and 50 km/s

evidence.quote: We measure a continuum flux density $S_{1.2 mm} = 2.17 \pm 0.04$ mJy
we derive a molecular gas mass $M_{H_2} = (1.65\, \pm \, 0.04)\times 10^9\, \mathrm{M_{\odot}}$
The disc model has a position angle PA = $248 \pm 5$ deg
We find values that range from $Q_{gas}\approx$ 0.5 up to 10
whose total molecular outflow rate is in the range 6.4 - 17.0 $\mathrm{M_\odot/yr}$

not_stated_but_needed: Spectral windows, channel widths and line-free channel ranges used for continuum
Regions/masks used to extract spectra A and B and how v98 and S_CO were measured
3DBarolo parameters (rings, widths, mask, normalisation, fitting settings)
Conversion of CO(2-1) to CO(1-0) (r21) used for alpha_CO
How uncertainties on M_dyn were propagated
missing_for_reproduction: Region definitions for A and B
score_reason: Data and main imaging steps stated and public via archive, but 3DBarolo settings and region extractions are missing.
rediscovery_reason: Single public dataset, mostly stated imaging recipe, numeric results (gas mass, flux, outflow rates).
